data.name: Ruqayeh
data.gender_notes: Ruqayeh is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is devoted to healing and protection. The name Ruqayeh carries the meaning “Healing, Protection” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ruqayeh usually hope their child will grow to embody healing, protection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who will be blessed with the power to heal and protect
data.etymology: Ruqayeh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Healing, Protection.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ruqayeh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: رُقَيَّة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم بنت، يعني الرفعة في العلم والشرف
in_arabic.long_meaning: رُقَيَّة اسم مشتق من رَقِيَ يَرقَى رُقِيًّا، وهو اسم بنت النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، وتعني الرفعة في العلم والشرف، وفي اللغة العربية تعني رُقَيَّة: رفعة وعلو في جميع الأحوال

in_urdu.name: رقیہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: رقیہ یہ نام رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کی بیٹی کا ہے، جو کہ علم و شرافت میں رفعت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، عربی زبان میں اس کا مطلب ہے: رفعت و علو

in_hindi.name: रुक़याह
in_hindi.long_meaning: रुक़याह यह नाम पैगंबर मुहम्मद की बेटी का है, जो विज्ञान और सम्मान में ऊंचाई को दर्शाता है, अरबी भाषा में इसका अर्थ है: ऊंचाई और सभी मामलों में उत्कृष्टता

in_pashto.name: رقيه
in_pashto.long_meaning: رقيه د رسول الله صلی الله عليه وسلم د لور نوم دی، چې د علم او شرافت لوړتوب څرګندوي، په عربي ژبه کې يې مطلب دی: لوړتوب او په ټولو چارو کې غوره والی

in_english.name: Ruqayeh
in_english.long_meaning: Ruqayeh is derived from the Arabic root 'رَقِيَ' which means 'to rise' or 'to ascend'. It is the name of the daughter of Prophet Muhammad. The name signifies elevation in knowledge, nobility, and status. It reflects spiritual growth and high moral character.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: رقيه

data.cultural_impact: Ruqayah is a name of Arabic origin, widely recognized in the Islamic world. In the Islamic cultural context, this name holds significant meaning as it is associated with healing and protection. Ruqayah is often used for individuals who are believed to possess healing abilities, or who are dedicated to providing comfort and relief from distress, both physical and emotional. The name also carries forward the rich cultural legacy of the Arabic language and represents the diverse human experiences within the Islamic community.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ruqayah signifies a place of refuge, comfort, and solace. Those who bear this name are seen as vessels of divine guidance and protection. Ruqayah is characterized by a deep sense of compassion, empathy, and a dedicated connection to the spiritual realm. In her role as a healer, she embodies the essence of compassionate care, echoing the sustaining and nurturing influence of the Divine Providence. Additionally, the practice of Ruqyah, which is a form of spiritual healing, is deeply entrenched in the Islamic tradition, reflecting the belief in the interconnectedness of all aspects of human life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Healing, Protection" symbolizes One who is devoted to healing and protection. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ruqayeh serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of healing, protection.
